body.statement:
Put \(A_{n,m,\tau}:=\ell\min\{1,N^{-\varkappa}\}\) and \(L_m:=\log(2m)\). Restrict the unresolved regret problem to the unsaturated strict sub-familywise region
\[
A_{n,m,\tau}<L_m^{1-\varkappa},
\qquad
A_{n,m,\tau}\left[1+A_{n,m,\tau}^{\varkappa/(1-\varkappa)}\right]<\ell.
\]
No case with \(N<1\) lies in this region. The proved bounds there are
\[
c_{\beta,D}A_{n,m,\tau}
\left[1+A_{n,m,\tau}^{\varkappa/(1-\varkappa)}\right]
\le\mathcal R(n,m,\tau)
\le C_{\beta,D}\min\{\ell,A_{n,m,\tau}L_m^{\varkappa}\}
=C_{\beta,D}\mathcal B_{\mathrm{CK}}(n,m,\tau).
\]
Determine \(\mathcal R(n,m,\tau)\) up to constants depending only on \(\beta,D\) within this remaining region. In particular, construct one computable capacity-aware learner over the full heterogeneous class \(\mathcal H_{\beta,D}(m)\) that attains the lower expression, including sparse-dominance, collective-contribution, and local-to-tied mixtures, or prove that another same-class configuration raises the lower bound. Determine whether \(A_{n,m,\tau}\to0\), which is necessary for vanishing regret, is sufficient, or whether the stronger currently sufficient condition \(A_{n,m,\tau}L_m^{\varkappa}\to0\) is necessary. Equivalently, identify the maximal subregimes of this unsaturated phase on which capacity averaging yields \(\mathcal R(n,m,\tau)=o\{\mathcal B_{\mathrm{CK}}(n,m,\tau)\}\). The existing coordinatewise learner \(\widehat\pi_{\mathrm{tail}}\) remains only the upper witness; no nonzero policy-selection price is assumed.
body.justification: The familywise phase, the saturated strict sub-familywise phase, and the all-vanishing-regime regular-policy comparison are settled; the remaining headline contribution is exactly the localized selected-mixture frontier in the unsaturated strict sub-familywise region.
body.gap: CarpentierKim2015 supplies translated one-tail familywise machinery but no randomized capacity-selected mixture oracle inequality in the remaining unsaturated region, and AtheyWager2021 supplies no moving extreme-mixture rate.
body.consumer: Resolving the remaining unsaturated gap would tell users of the non-nested upper-cost-quantile objective in OsamaZachariahStoica2020 exactly when capacity averaging permits reliable Hall extrapolation beyond both certified obstruction regions.

obligation.what_is_open: Within \(A_{n,m,\tau}<L_m^{1-\varkappa}\) and \(A_{n,m,\tau}[1+A_{n,m,\tau}^{\varkappa/(1-\varkappa)}]<\ell\), match the proved lower rate with one computable learner over the full heterogeneous Hall class, or exhibit a harder same-class configuration; thereby decide the exact vanishing criterion and the maximal strict-improvement regimes relative to \(\mathcal B_{\mathrm{CK}}(n,m,\tau)\).
obligation.obstruction: Simultaneous coordinatewise control attains only \(\min\{\ell,A_{n,m,\tau}L_m^{\varkappa}\}\). In the remaining unsaturated region, the missing oracle inequality must instead control the random mixture mass of severely underestimated arms selected under capacity, uniformly over heterogeneous indices and local ties; the frozen primitives provide no such localized selected-mixture concentration result.
obligation.attempted: The paired product-prior converse, fixed-sample posterior factorization, capacity exchange, binomial missed-cell lower bound, and amplitude optimization close the lower side. Direct algebra from that lower envelope also closes the newly separated saturated sub-familywise region. A natural-threshold empirical minimizer and an average multiplicative core comparison were tried in the remaining region, but rare severe underestimation can be selected adaptively; restoring simultaneous control reproduces the coordinatewise logarithmic factor.
obligation.partial_result:
Put \(A_{n,m,\tau}:=\ell\min\{1,N^{-\varkappa}\}\) and \(L_m:=\log(2m)\). Two regions are closed. If \(A_{n,m,\tau}\ge L_m^{1-\varkappa}\), then \(\mathcal R(n,m,\tau)\asymp_{\beta,D}\mathcal B_{\mathrm{CK}}(n,m,\tau)\). If \(A_{n,m,\tau}<L_m^{1-\varkappa}\) but \(A_{n,m,\tau}[1+A_{n,m,\tau}^{\varkappa/(1-\varkappa)}]\ge\ell\), then \(\mathcal R(n,m,\tau)\asymp_{\beta,D}\ell\asymp\mathcal B_{\mathrm{CK}}(n,m,\tau)\); every \(N<1\) case satisfying the first inequality is in this second region. In the remaining unsaturated sub-familywise region,
\[
c_{\beta,D}A_{n,m,\tau}\left[1+A_{n,m,\tau}^{\varkappa/(1-\varkappa)}\right]
\le\mathcal R(n,m,\tau)
\le C_{\beta,D}\min\{\ell,A_{n,m,\tau}L_m^{\varkappa}\}.
\]
Thus \(A_{n,m,\tau}\to0\) remains necessary and \(A_{n,m,\tau}L_m^{\varkappa}\to0\) remains sufficient for vanishing regret; equality of those criteria can only fail or be proved inside this last region.
